transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the weekly sustainment review. I need confirmed updates from each of you before I can sign the disposition plan for the items currently in the holding area. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps — please go ahead and report your confirmed updates so I can record them and get the plan signed.

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I have a confirmed update on the used oil drums. This morning I confirmed that the used oil consists of exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file, but I should note it has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I have a confirmed update on the vehicle batteries. I counted exactly 24 cases in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so the shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I want to flag that this information has not yet been sent to logistics.
